name: Stockist Dashboard Stats
script:
new_orders = frappe.db.sql("select count(*) from `tabSales Order` where order_type='Shopping Cart' and docstatus=1 and status not in ('Completed','Closed','Cancelled')")[0][0]
today_sales = frappe.db.sql("select coalesce(sum(grand_total),0) from `tabSales Order` where order_type='Shopping Cart' and docstatus=1 and transaction_date=CURDATE()")[0][0]
total_dues = frappe.db.sql("select coalesce(sum(legacy_due_amount),0) from `tabCustomer`")[0][0]
active_customers = frappe.db.sql("select count(distinct parent) from `tabPortal User` where parenttype='Customer'")[0][0]
total_customers = frappe.db.count("Customer")
frappe.response["message"] = {
	"new_orders": new_orders,
	"today_sales": float(today_sales),
	"total_dues": float(total_dues),
	"active_customers": active_customers,
	"total_customers": total_customers,
}

name: Stockist Customer Access List
Stockist Reset Customer PIN
script:
customer = args.get("customer")
row = frappe.db.sql("""
	select pu.user from `tabPortal User` pu
	where pu.parent = %s and pu.parenttype = 'Customer' limit 1
""", (customer,), as_dict=True)
if not row:
	frappe.throw("This customer has no login yet - use Grant Access instead.")
email = row[0].user
pin = str(int(frappe.db.sql("select floor(100000 + rand()*900000)")[0][0]))
user = frappe.get_doc("User", email)
user.new_password = pin
user.flags.ignore_password_policy = True
user.enabled = 1
user.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"mobile_no": user.mobile_no, "pin": pin}

name: Stockist Grant Customer Access
script:
customer = args.get("customer")
mobile_no = args.get("mobile_no")
if not mobile_no:
	frappe.throw("Mobile number is required to grant access.")
existing = frappe.db.sql("""
	select pu.user from `tabPortal User` pu
	where pu.parent = %s and pu.parenttype = 'Customer' limit 1
""", (customer,), as_dict=True)
pin = str(int(frappe.db.sql("select floor(100000 + rand()*900000)")[0][0]))
if existing:
	email = existing[0].user
	user = frappe.get_doc("User", email)
	user.new_password = pin
	user.flags.ignore_password_policy = True
	user.enabled = 1
	user.mobile_no = mobile_no
	user.save(ignore_permissions=True)
else:
	email = f"{mobile_no}@portal.local"
	cust_name = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", customer, "customer_name")
	if frappe.db.exists("User", email):
		user = frappe.get_doc("User", email)
		user.new_password = pin
		user.flags.ignore_password_policy = True
		user.enabled = 1
		user.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	else:
		user = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "User", "email": email, "first_name": (cust_name or customer)[:140],
			"mobile_no": mobile_no, "send_welcome_email": 0, "user_type": "Website User",
			"enabled": 1, "new_password": pin, "roles": [{"role": "Customer"}],
		})
		user.flags.ignore_permissions = True
		user.flags.ignore_password_policy = True
		try:
			user.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
		except Exception as e:
			if "Throttled" in str(e):
				frappe.throw("Too many new logins created recently. Please wait a few minutes and try again.")
			raise
	cust = frappe.get_doc("Customer", customer)
	if not any(pu.user == email for pu in cust.portal_users):
		cust.append("portal_users", {"user": email})
		cust.mobile_no = mobile_no
		cust.flags.ignore_permissions = True
		cust.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"mobile_no": mobile_no, "pin": pin}

name: Stockist Toggle Customer Access
script:
customer = args.get("customer")
enable = args.get("enable")
enable = 1 if str(enable) in ("1", "true", "True") else 0
row = frappe.db.sql("""
	select pu.user from `tabPortal User` pu
	where pu.parent = %s and pu.parenttype = 'Customer' limit 1
""", (customer,), as_dict=True)
if not row:
	frappe.throw("This customer has no login to revoke/restore.")
frappe.db.set_value("User", row[0].user, "enabled", enable)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"enabled": bool(enable)}

name: Stockist Products List
script:
items = frappe.db.sql("""
	select i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_group, i.brand, i.disabled, i.admin_overridden,
		ip.price_list_rate, wi.route
	from `tabItem` i
	left join `tabItem Price` ip on ip.item_code = i.item_code and ip.price_list = 'Standard Selling'
	left join `tabWebsite Item` wi on wi.item_code = i.item_code
	order by i.item_name
""", as_dict=True)

frappe.response["message"] = {
	"items": [
		{
			"item_code": r.item_code,
			"item_name": r.item_name,
			"item_group": r.item_group,
			"brand": r.brand,
			"active": not r.disabled,
			"overridden": bool(r.admin_overridden),
			"price": float(r.price_list_rate or 0),
			"published": bool(r.route),
		}
		for r in items
	]
}

name: Stockist Update Product
script:
item_code = args.get("item_code")
new_name = args.get("item_name")
new_price = args.get("price")
new_group = args.get("item_group")
new_active = args.get("active")

if not item_code:
	frappe.throw("Missing item_code")

item = frappe.get_doc("Item", item_code)
if new_name:
	item.item_name = new_name[:140]
if new_group:
	item.item_group = new_group
if new_active is not None:
	item.disabled = 0 if str(new_active) in ("1", "true", "True") else 1
item.admin_overridden = 1
item.flags.ignore_permissions = True
item.save(ignore_permissions=True)

wi_name = frappe.db.get_value("Website Item", {"item_code": item_code}, "name")
if wi_name and new_name:
	wi = frappe.get_doc("Website Item", wi_name)
	wi.web_item_name = new_name[:140]
	wi.item_group = item.item_group
	wi.flags.ignore_permissions = True
	wi.save(ignore_permissions=True)

if new_price is not None:
	existing = frappe.db.get_value(
		"Item Price", {"item_code": item_code, "price_list": "Standard Selling"}, "name"
	)
	price_val = float(new_price)
	if existing:
		ip = frappe.get_doc("Item Price", existing)
		ip.price_list_rate = price_val
		ip.flags.ignore_permissions = True
		ip.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	else:
		frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "Item Price", "item_code": item_code, "price_list": "Standard Selling",
			"price_list_rate": price_val, "currency": "INR", "selling": 1,
		}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "ok"}

name: Stockist Coupons List
script:
rows = frappe.db.sql("""
	select cc.name, cc.coupon_code, cc.maximum_use, cc.used, cc.valid_upto,
		pr.discount_percentage, pr.discount_amount, pr.rate_or_discount, pr.disable
	from `tabCoupon Code` cc
	left join `tabPricing Rule` pr on pr.name = cc.pricing_rule
	order by cc.creation desc
""", as_dict=True)

frappe.response["message"] = {
	"coupons": [
		{
			"name": r.name,
			"code": r.coupon_code,
			"discount": (f"{r.discount_percentage:g}%" if r.rate_or_discount == "Discount Percentage" else f"Rs.{r.discount_amount:g}"),
			"used": r.used or 0,
			"max_use": r.maximum_use or 0,
			"valid_upto": str(r.valid_upto) if r.valid_upto else None,
			"active": not r.disable,
		}
		for r in rows
	]
}

name: Stockist Create Coupon
script:
code = (args.get("code") or "").strip().upper()
discount_type = args.get("discount_type")
discount_value = args.get("discount_value")
max_use = args.get("max_use")
valid_upto = args.get("valid_upto")

if not code:
	frappe.throw("Coupon code is required")
if frappe.db.exists("Coupon Code", code):
	frappe.throw(f"Coupon code {code} already exists")
if not discount_value:
	frappe.throw("Discount value is required")

pr = frappe.get_doc({
	"doctype": "Pricing Rule",
	"title": f"Coupon: {code}",
	"apply_on": "Transaction",
	"price_or_product_discount": "Price",
	"rate_or_discount": "Discount Percentage" if discount_type == "percentage" else "Discount Amount",
	"discount_percentage": float(discount_value) if discount_type == "percentage" else 0,
	"discount_amount": float(discount_value) if discount_type == "amount" else 0,
	"selling": 1,
	"coupon_code_based": 1,
	"company": "test",
	"currency": "INR",
})
if valid_upto:
	pr.valid_upto = valid_upto
pr.flags.ignore_permissions = True
pr.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

cc = frappe.get_doc({
	"doctype": "Coupon Code",
	"coupon_name": code,
	"coupon_code": code,
	"coupon_type": "Promotional",
	"pricing_rule": pr.name,
	"maximum_use": int(max_use) if max_use else 0,
})
if valid_upto:
	cc.valid_upto = valid_upto
cc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
cc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "ok", "code": code}

name: Stockist Toggle Coupon
script:
name = args.get("name")
enable = args.get("enable")
enable = 1 if str(enable) in ("1", "true", "True") else 0

cc = frappe.get_doc("Coupon Code", name)
if cc.pricing_rule:
	pr = frappe.get_doc("Pricing Rule", cc.pricing_rule)
	pr.disable = 0 if enable else 1
	pr.flags.ignore_permissions = True
	pr.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"active": bool(enable)}

name: Stockist Announcements List
Stockist Create Announcement
script:
title = (args.get("title") or "").strip()
announcement_type = args.get("announcement_type") or "Banner"
message = (args.get("message") or "").strip()
end_date = args.get("end_date")

if not title or not message:
	frappe.throw("Title and message are required")

doc = frappe.get_doc({
	"doctype": "Storefront Announcement",
	"title": title,
	"announcement_type": announcement_type,
	"message": message,
	"is_active": 1,
	"end_date": end_date or None,
})
doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()
frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "ok", "name": doc.name}

name: Stockist Toggle Announcement
